mapping.status_policy: Only CONFIRMED mappings are eligible for automatic use.

disclaimer: AFRSTAT:AFR_TRADE is an independent portfolio demonstration model. This mapping is not an official African Union or STATAFRIC harmonisation specification.

transformations.name: Identity metadata
transformations.description: Records confirmed semantic identity; code passthrough is never implied when an explicit code mapping is required.

transformations.name: Canonical geography lookup
transformations.description: Resolve provider geography through source_geo_mapping and geo_area before selecting a target area code.

transformations.name: Trade-flow code lookup
transformations.description: Resolve source trade-flow codes using explicit code mappings.

transformations.name: Product classification lookup
transformations.description: Derive the target product scheme from classification-aware source commodity metadata.

transformations.name: Classification-aware product lookup
transformations.description: Resolve a source commodity only within its declared classification context.

transformations.name: Measure and unit derivation
transformations.description: Derive USD and an unscaled multiplier only when the UN Comtrade primary value is evidenced as the current-dollar CIF trade value for the supported import path.

transformations.name: Controlled provider provenance
transformations.description: Derive the controlled target source code from exact provider metadata; no URL or credential is copied.
